title: Prior Authorization Clinical Policy: Glucagon-Like Peptide-1 (GLP-1) Receptor Agonists for Chronic Weight Management
regulatory_framework: CMS-0057-F / ERISA 29 CFR 2560.503-1 / FDA Wegovy Prescribing Information
summary: Mandates criteria-grounded coverage review for semaglutide (Wegovy) 2.4 mg subcutaneous weekly. Requires confirmed BMI thresholds, lifestyle intervention trial, documentation recency, and absence of boxed-warning contraindications.

criteria.name: Body Mass Index >= 30 kg/m2 (Obese)
criteria.description: Patient must have documented baseline Body Mass Index (BMI) greater than or equal to 30.0 kg/m2.
criteria.statutory_reference: FDA Wegovy Prescribing Information Section 1; CMS-0057-F

criteria.name: Body Mass Index >= 27 kg/m2 with Comorbidity
criteria.description: Patient has BMI >= 27.0 kg/m2 AND at least one documented weight-related comorbidity (hypertension, T2DM, dyslipidemia, obstructive sleep apnea).

criteria.name: Documented Weight-Related Comorbidity
criteria.description: Presence of hypertension, type 2 diabetes, dyslipidemia, or OSA.
criteria.statutory_reference: AACE/ACE Clinical Practice Guidelines for Obesity

criteria.name: Trial of Structured Lifestyle Intervention >= 6 Months
criteria.description: Documented participation in a comprehensive lifestyle intervention (reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity) for at least 6 consecutive months prior to medication request.
criteria.statutory_reference: National Coverage Determination (NCD) & Plan UM Manual § 4.2

criteria.name: Weight and Vitals Recency (<= 90 Days)
criteria.description: Baseline weight and height/BMI measured in clinical office visit within 90 days preceding authorization request.

criteria.name: Exclusion: Personal or Family History of Medullary Thyroid Carcinoma
criteria.description: Contraindicated in patients with a personal or family history of Medullary Thyroid Carcinoma (MTC) or Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2).
criteria.statutory_reference: FDA Black Box Warning (Semaglutide package insert Section 4)

criteria.name: Exclusion: Current Pregnancy or Lactation
criteria.description: Contraindicated during pregnancy; potential for fetal harm.

groups.title: BMI Eligibility (Obese OR Overweight with Comorbidity)
